description: Execute a SQL query asynchronously on Ncloud Data Query. Returns execution ID immediately. Use ncloud_dataquery_get_result to retrieve results.

dataSource.description: Data source name for query execution

executionParameters.description: Query execution parameters (for parameterized queries with '?')

isReuse.description: Whether to reuse cached query results (default: false)

reuseMaxAge.description: Max age in minutes for reusing cached results (1-10080, default: 60). Required if isReuse=true

name: ncloud_dataquery_execute_async
